ranked_opportunity_buckets.scoring: Scores use bucket-specific fixed eligibility bases, fixed bonuses for the preferred API/customer-access/no-toolkit conditions, and 0–2 for the presence of high/medium evidence quality; ties break alphabetically. Scores rank triage order and are not probabilities.

errors.message: Open multi-customer distribution requires evidence about public/distributable integration setup.
App-review distribution requires evidence of review, approval, production gating, or public-app review.

A name-matching candidate conflicts with the assignment hint/context and cannot be accepted automatically.

warnings.message: Identity uncertainty requires human or deeper research review.
Identity hint conflict requires deeper research or human review.

verification.note: The verifier challenged proposals and preserved disagreements; it did not provide ground truth.

exact_field_agreement.definition: Exact equality across all human-adjudicable fields; approved unknown values are included in this agreement denominator.

resolved_field_accuracy.definition: correct / (correct + wrong); partial disagreements are included in wrong, while automation abstentions and human-unresolved fields are excluded.

schema_repair_improvement.comparison: immutable packet before_schema_repair vs after_schema_repair, then approved final value

holdout.note: This is a human-reviewed calibration result for the fixed 30-app holdout, not an estimate of accuracy across all 100 apps. Post-human values are adjudicated ground truth, not a model-accuracy measurement.
